issues.problem: pt-toshitemo example 忙しいにしても: English 'Busy or not' misstates the concession (にしても grants that you were busy).
issues.action: English changed to 'Even if you were busy, you could at least have phoned.'

issues.problem: pt-toshitemo mistake 宝くじが当たったとしても、家を買いたい is not clearly wrong ('even if I won, I'd still want a house' is a possible reading).
issues.action: Replaced with a question about consequences (何がしたいですか), where としても is clearly out and としたら is required.

issues.problem: pt-toshitemo mistake good form 子どもにしては、この絵はとても上手だ is awkward (the picture is not the child), and the explain claimed にしては only covers results that beat the standard.
issues.action: Mistake rewritten as 弟は六歳にしては、字がとても上手だ; explain now says the result departs from the yardstick in either direction.

issues.problem: pt-bayokatta explain said ばよかったのに always reproaches someone else; it can also be self-directed regret.
pt-dokoroka rule and explain said どころか always denies X, missing the common scaling-up use (一万円どころか十万円もかかった), so the piano/violin どころか mistake was not clearly wrong.
issues.action: Added the scaling-up use to rule, explain, contrast and tip; replaced the mistake with a scaling-down sentence where ばかりか is clearly wrong (旅行ばかりか、買い物に行く時間もない).

issues.problem: pt-dokoroka contrast note for ばかりか only described どころか as throwing X out.
issues.action: Note now says どころか throws X out or says it falls far short.
